timelineEvents.title: Involvement in Polish cultural life in Berlin
timelineEvents.label: 1929 · Polish cultural life in Berlin
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper conducts a concert of the Berlin “Harmonja” given within the Polish community.
timelineEvents.longDescription: In its report on the Polish colony in Berlin, the Berlin correspondent of “Kurjer Warszawski” (27 March 1929) records that a concert of the Berlin “Harmonja,” conducted by “the young composer dr. Bronisław Kaper,” took place strictly within the Polish community, with the tenor Salecki of the Dresden Opera and the soprano Głowacka. The report covers the preceding months and gives no date for the concert; it does not describe the ensemble further. In his 1975 oral history Kaper recalled conducting “the Polish Choir” in Berlin.
